prompt.editTarget: Image 1 is the authoritative full-resolution daytime scene.
prompt.poseReferences: The selected H3 full frame and its enlarged mouth crop are pose references only.
prompt.editableRegion: Change only the lips, visible inner mouth, and the smallest necessary nearby lower cheek, jawline, and chin deformation.
prompt.sequence: A natural moderately open /a/ pose, then a slightly shallower and more lateral intermediate pose, then a visibly shallower lateral /e/ pose.
prompt.invariants: Preserve the exact full scene, character identity, 1x mouth scale, camera, composition, lighting, colors, body, head, hands, objects, and background.
prompt.avoid: No exaggerated mouth, oversized lips, face movement, skin-tone drift, global repainting, crop, transparency, blur, feathering, text, watermark, unsupported teeth, or unsupported tongue.

review.note: User-approved full-scene sources retained without review media. The three runtime bridge assets were removed so open transitions directly to wide.
